result.title: WeVisOne-VL: Unified Visual Perception from Objects to Pixels
result.summary: Existing vision-language models (VLMs) remain unreliable for fine-grained visual perception. In this report, we present WeVisOne-VL (WeChat Vision All-in-One), a powerful VLM that unifies object-level and pixel-level perception through structured next-token prediction. It supports multiple visual tasks including object detection, referring localization, counting, OCR, segmentation, and matting, enabling localization at any user-specific granularity, from points and boxes to masks and alpha mattes. Architecturally, we integrate a lightweight pixel decoder into the VLM via a special <OBJ> token to generate instance-level pixel outputs. We train the model with a three-stage curriculum SFT followed by mixed-task RL. Across over 30 benchmarks, WeVisOne-VL demonstrates leading performance on both object-level and pixel-level tasks, while maintaining robust rejection for object-absent queries. By releasing WeVisOne-VL to the open-source community, we hope to advance VLMs from broad visual understanding toward truly reliable perception systems for real-world deployment.

AI.brief_summary: WeVisOne-VL 是一个统一对象级与像素级视觉感知的 VLM，通过特殊 <OBJ> token 接入轻量像素解码器，以结构化下一 token 预测方式支持检测、指代定位、计数、OCR、分割与抠图，并用三阶段课程式 SFT 加混合任务 RL 训练。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于通用 VLM 多任务感知能力与刷分工作，仅借特殊 token 扩展输出粒度，未研究推理期 latent 状态、视觉证据筛选或贡献分配，缺少可供核查的 LVR 借鉴线索。
